characters.title: Bacon (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: A 17-year-old entity with True Narrative Transcendence and Authorial Awareness.

characters.title: Anti-Narrative (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: The physical manifestation of author's block. It consumes narratives.

characters.title: Shadow (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: A dark, abstract VIP of the Bounty Hunters Association who drinks the light around him.

characters.title: Alvin (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: A highly paid Bounty Hunter who commands the reality-bending Red Void.

characters.title: Herald (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: Wears sunglasses despite the dim light. Doesn't explain how he survives.

characters.title: Shasha (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: An overly affectionate bounty hunter who traps victims in her dark pocket dimension.

characters.title: Bob (The Endless Narrative)
characters.desc: A self-important cosmic bounty hunter with time-stopping abilities.

characters.title: Bacon (Fallen Kingdom of Laymon)
characters.desc: The highly destructive, deadpan protector of the crown who uses developer commands and tactical nukes.

characters.title: King Laymon (Fallen Kingdom of Laymon)
characters.desc: The traumatized, deposed monarch who is dragged across dimensions by his lunatic knight.

characters.title: Shadow (Fallen Kingdom of Laymon)
characters.desc: The dark architect of Laymon's ruin who shatters reality and commands the void.

characters.title: The Experiments (Fallen Kingdom of Laymon)
characters.desc: Three incredibly powerful mutant bosses who never get to finish their dramatic monologues.

stories.title: The Endless Narrative
stories.desc: Follow Bacon as he explodes houses, joins the Bounty Hunters Association, gets a $10M bounty, and deletes cosmic entities across a chaotic universe.
